why: Real AH-1W (and AH-1S/AH-1F) tandem canopy: flat acrylic plates in a light frame, no curved glass. Gunner (front): a raked flat windscreen between the two A-pillars, a small flat overhead plate, a door plate and a quarter plate each side; pilot (rear): a flat door plate each side and a small flat overhead plate in the roof; the pilot looks forward over the gunner's canopy. Layout from the War Thunder ah_1w model and AH-1W photographs (the AH-1Z's different canopy was not used). The pilot's reflector-sight combiner (also in CanopyGlass) is excluded by the box ranges.
